research_result.description: systeme.io is an all-in-one marketing platform for sales funnels, email campaigns, online courses, and digital product management. It provides a RESTful Public API and a native MCP server for interacting with platform resources.
research_result.credential_requirements: Users can generate Public API keys and MCP keys directly from their systeme.io account dashboard under Settings > MCP & API keys. Accounts can hold up to 3 Public API keys and 2 MCP keys at a time.

evidence.claim: Systeme.io provides a RESTful Public API for managing contacts, tags, funnels, newsletters, courses, and other platform resources.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Adhering to RESTful conventions, our API ensures an intuitive and consistent interaction pattern for all users.

evidence.claim: Public API authentication requires attaching an API key to the X-API-Key header of each request.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, your only option right now is to attach your API key to the`X-API-Key` header of each request.

evidence.claim: Users can generate API keys directly from their account dashboard settings.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: To create a public API key, click your profile picture, select Settings (1), and scroll down to MCP & API keys (2).

evidence.claim: Systeme.io offers a native MCP server for AI tools to interact with platform data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The new MCP server feature gives users, partners, and developers a powerful new way to interact with systeme.io using AI tools.
